reasons: The two answers are nearly identical. Both correct the real-name premise at the start, cite Civil Code arts. 19/145 and the SPC Guiding Opinion (II) by its full name (without 法发〔2020〕17号 or 第9条), and write a letter that states the child is 11, gives the 6480 yuan in about a dozen payments, asks for a full refund with a 70% fallback (4536 yuan, which checks out) and does not concede adult spending. Both lay out the same escalation path and the same prevention steps. A hedges its menu paths ('在账单页面找下载账单') and links to official Apple pages. B adds an unsourced Apple '90 天内' limit and exact menu paths, one of which (the WeChat bill export option name) does not match the app's labels. B does have small pluses: example placeholders in the letter, a correct 50-yuan court fee halved under simple procedure, and the Tencent 家长服务平台 name. Both are too long for the medium and both partly endorse the user's acceptance of blame.
